items.title: Hyperscale Data Sells Remaining Bitcoin Holdings for $16 Million to Reduce Debt and Fund AI Data Center
items.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. (AMEX:GPUS) announced that it has sold its remaining Bitcoin reserves for approximately $16 million, with proceeds being directed towards debt reduction and the continued development of its artificial intelligence data centre in Michigan.

items.title: American Express (AXP) Unveils Sports Rewards Card Tied To Fan Loyalty
items.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) and Fanatics have launched a new co-branded credit card focused on sports fans and bettors. The product links American Express Membership Rewards with Fanatics FanCash, allowing cardholders to direct points into the Fanatics ecosystem. Card users receive access to Fanatics-related experiences and merchandise offers that are tied to sports events and team loyalty programs.
